name: Popover
layerWhy: It holds a little beside the page; the page stays the person's own.
promise: A few details or a small task beside its button, gone when you press outside.
expectation: A raised box against its button.
evidence: Focus moves into it if it holds something to press, and returns to the button on close.
behaviour: Opens and closes from its button; Escape and a press outside close it.
Placed against its button, flipped when there is no room, in either direction.
context: Small details or a small form about one thing.
relationships: Its button says what it holds.
accessibility: role="dialog" with a label; aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the button.
failures: Never drops focus to the top of the page.
dont: A popover for a long form.

usage.markup:
<primal-popover label="Share link">
  <button primalPopoverTrigger primalButton type="button">Copy Share Link</button>
  …what it holds…
</primal-popover>
